sections.title: Adverbs of Gradual Change
sections.content: You know *fokozatosan* ('gradually') from A2 Unit 18: it is a manner adverb in *-an/-en* (A2 Unit 19). Here are more ways to say that change happens slowly: *lépésről lépésre* ('step by step') and *fokról fokra* ('degree by degree') use the endings *-ról/-ről* and *-ra/-re* that you know from A1 Unit 31 and A2 Unit 6. To describe a period between two others, use *átmenetet képez* ('forms a transition between').

items.spanish: A reformokat nem azonnal, hanem fokozatosan vezették be.
items.english: The reforms were introduced not immediately, but gradually.

items.spanish: Az új épület harmonikus átmenetet képez a régi és az új városrész között.
items.english: The new building forms a harmonious transition between the old and new parts of town.
